captions.head: Earth spins 2x faster
captions.sub: Air, oceans and you spin with it. If not: 1,200 km/h winds.

captions.head: You get 0.5% lighter
captions.sub: 4x the centrifugal pull: 70 kg reads 69.6 kg.

captions.head: A day lasts 12 hours
captions.sub: The Sun still crawls: 0.008° a second.

captions.head: The oceans start sliding
captions.sub: Toward the equator, a bit faster every second.

captions.head: So does the air
captions.sub: A breeze toward the equator, building to 1 m/s.

captions.head: Earth gains 6 × 10²⁹ J
captions.sub: 4x the spin energy: 28 minutes of the Sun's output.

captions.head: Back to normal
captions.sub: But the oceans are still moving at 1 m/s.

captions.head: Tsunamis
captions.sub: Where that water hits a coast, it piles up metres high.
